title: Thai Coconut Khanom Krok
description: A creamy and fragrant dessert inspired by traditional Thai street food, made with coconut milk, khanom krok flour, and a touch of sweetness.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan or khanom krok mold over medium heat.
In a separate bowl, whisk together coconut milk, khanom krok flour, nutty sugar, and vanilla extract.
Add the melted coconut oil to the bowl and whisk until smooth.
Pour the mixture into the preheated pan or khanom krok mold.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges towards the center.
Continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes or until the khanom krok is lightly golden brown.
Remove from heat and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm with a dollop of coconut cream and a sprinkle of khanom krok flour.
